title: Adopted runtime-started Claude turns report a known success or error to Engram as outcome=unknown (first close records Unknown and removes the trace)
outcome: An adopted Claude turn's observed terminal result (success or error) is the outcome reported to Engram; no earlier Unknown close pre-empts it.
acceptance: For adopted runtime-started Claude turns, the known result reaches the single runtime-observation close (pass it into the first close, or let the guarded terminal path perform the sole close), so the closing job/report carries Succeeded or Failed.
Behavioural tests cover the adopted success callback and the adopted error callback (including the unresolved adopted interval path) and assert the reported outcome.

completion.summary: Adopted Claude terminal success/error now reaches the first guarded observation close.
